title: Contact form submits successfully and resets for another inquiry
description: This verifies that a visitor can submit the contact form successfully and then start a second message with a cleared form.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid inquiry
Submit the form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the form is reset and ready for a new message

title: Submit a contact inquiry successfully
description: This test verifies that a visitor can fill out the contact form and receive a confirmation after submitting a valid inquiry.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the form
Verify a confirmation message is visible
Verify the form is reset for a new inquiry

title: Home page preloader and hero reveal
description: This verifies that the homepage loads through the preloader sequence and reveals the animated hero introduction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the preloader sequence to complete
Verify the animated hero introduction is displayed
Verify the rotating brand words are displayed

title: Browse the homepage sections after the initial reveal
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the homepage, experience the loading and hero reveal sequence, and continue into the About, Services, and Projects sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the preloader to finish
Scroll to the About section
Scroll to the Services section
Scroll to the Projects section
Verify the About, Services, and Projects sections are displayed

title: Featured project link opens the live external website
description: This verifies that a featured project from the homepage projects showcase opens its live external website in a new context.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the projects section
Click the featured project live website link
Verify the external project website is displayed

title: Open a featured project from the showcase
description: This test verifies that a visitor can find a featured project on the homepage and open its live external website from the showcase.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Projects section
Click the external link for a featured project
Verify an external website is opened
Verify the project showcase remains available after returning

title: Home page scrolls to About from the contact call to action
description: This verifies that the homepage about content is readable and the contact call to action moves the user to the contact section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the about section
Verify the studio profile and credentials are displayed
Click the contact call to action
Verify the contact section is displayed

title: Jump from a project to the contact section
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the projects call to action to move into the contact area from the homepage.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Projects section
Click the contact call to action in the showcase
Verify the contact section is displayed

title: Home page scrolls to Projects from the work call to action
description: This verifies that the work call to action takes the user from the homepage about content to the projects section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the about section
Click the work call to action
Verify the projects section is displayed

title: Show validation for missing contact details
description: This test verifies that the contact form shows inline validation when required fields are left blank and the user tries to submit.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Submit the form
Verify validation feedback is visible for the required fields

title: Continue browsing after visiting a project link
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open a featured project externally and then return to continue exploring the portfolio homepage.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Projects section
Click the external link for a featured project
Return to the portfolio page
Scroll to the next homepage section after Projects
Verify the portfolio homepage remains navigable after the external visit

title: Services items expand to reveal details and imagery
description: This verifies that users can inspect a service by activating it and seeing its expanded details and preview imagery.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the services section
Activate a service item
Verify the selected service details are displayed
Verify service preview imagery is displayed

title: Show validation for an invalid email address
description: This test verifies that the contact form rejects an incorrectly formatted email address and keeps the inquiry from being submitted.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with an invalid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the form
Verify email validation feedback is visible

title: Contact form shows validation for missing required fields
description: This verifies that submitting the contact form without required information surfaces validation and prevents a successful submission state.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Submit the form without entering any information
Verify required field validation is visible
Verify no success confirmation is visible

title: Send another inquiry after a successful submission
description: This test verifies that a visitor can submit the contact form successfully and then reset it to send a second message.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the form
Click the option to send another inquiry
Verify the form is cleared for a new submission

title: Contact form shows validation for an invalid email
description: This verifies that the contact form rejects an invalid email format and surfaces a validation state before submission succeeds.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Fill in the email field with an invalid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid inquiry
Submit the form
Verify email validation is visible
Verify no success confirmation is visible

title: Standalone case study page is viewable
description: This verifies that the dedicated case study page loads and presents project showcase content.

steps.description: Navigate to /case-study
Verify the case study content is displayed

title: Standalone About page is viewable
description: This verifies that the dedicated about page loads and presents the studio background content.

steps.description: Navigate to /about
Verify the studio background content is displayed

title: View the standalone About page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the dedicated About page and read the studio background content.

steps.description: Navigate to /about
Verify the dedicated about content is displayed

title: View the case study showcase content
description: A visitor can open the standalone case study page and see its showcase content loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /case-study
Verify the case study showcase content is displayed

title: View the standalone case study page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the dedicated case study page and see the project showcase content.

steps.description: Navigate to /case-study
Verify case study content is displayed

title: Open the Sanity Studio dashboard
description: A content editor can access the embedded studio and see the management dashboard load.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Verify the embedded Sanity Studio dashboard is displayed

title: Sanity Studio dashboard loads for content editing
description: This verifies that the embedded Sanity Studio page loads and presents the content management interface.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Verify the content management dashboard is displayed
